rules.howSolved: The customer_name column is UNIQUE and the load uses SELECT DISTINCT, so each name is held once.
The load selects DISTINCT over every staging row with a non-null name, so no name is left out.
The WHERE clause customer_name IS NOT NULL leaves out shipments that have no customer name.
